title: Etale near a closed subset gives an etale principal localization
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\mathfrak b\subseteq B$ an ideal. Assume that for every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset B$ with $\mathfrak b\subseteq\mathfrak q$ there is $h\in B\setminus\mathfrak q$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}B_h\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then there is $g\in B$ whose image in $B/\mathfrak b$ is a unit such that $\operatorname{Spec}B_g\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M0 (lemma-localize-upstairs, line 1821) and its proof (the non-etale locus is closed, V(J') with V(J') ∩ V(J) empty, Algebra Lemma 00E0 lemma-Zariski-topology, 1 = f + g with f in J, g in J')
